name: 六本木
note: Roppongi plus Hinokicho Park and the Akasaka 9-chome blocks around it (north), Nishi-Azabu past Gonpachi (west) and Azabudai Hills (south).
spawnNote: The pavement on the corner outside ALMOND (アマンド), Roppongi's classic meeting point on the corner of Roppongi Crossing (六本木交差点), between the crosswalks over Roppongi-dori and Gaien-Higashi-dori.
